text:
maria: Heads up team, external pentest report just landed. 12 findings: 3 high, 4 medium, 5 low. Need to coordinate remediation owners, RBAC updates, KMS policy fixes, evidence packaging, and a retest window. Posting summary here to assign quick owners.
aj: Received. Can you paste the report link and which highs are actionable requiring environment access?
maria: Report: https://redwood-sec.s3/assessments/2026-03-21/external-report-v2.pdf
maria: Quick callouts: High A = debug endpoints leaking tokens; High B = admin role mapping allows unexpected principals; High C = KMS key policy with wildcard principal. High A needs log exports and code patch; High B likely needs role mapping + canary rollout; High C requires key policy change and CloudTrail proof.
tom: I'll prepare an evidence bundle: CloudTrail, API gateway logs, app logs (filtered), and key change history. Will redact PII and upload to assessment bucket.
lina: For log exports, include exact query strings and timestamps so assessor can verify remediation. Also include a snapshot of current key policy JSON and previous revisions.
infra-platform: On KMS key ownership: infra-platform owns 'rw-main-v1'. We can draft a least-privilege policy and propose a rollout. Need approval from security leads before applying.
pen-test-bot: evidence-bucket: upload complete (evidence-2026-03-21.tgz). Presigned URL available to reviewers until 2026-03-28.
katie: DevEx will own the remediation checklist and retest verification template (QA prompts and sample queries). I’ll publish the template and tag QA to run the verification suite pre-retest.
aj: On RBAC fix: plan to add a condition restricting assume-role by source IP and require MFA. Propose canary at 5-10% for admin actions via feature flag and monitor auth failures. What are acceptance criteria?
katie: Suggest acceptance: auth success >= 99.5% for canary subset, no regression in request latency, and no increase in 4xx/5xx rates. Also include unit/integration tests.
lina: Log verification queries for the assessor (CloudWatch Insights example):
```
fields @timestamp, @message
| filter @message like /token leak|DEBUG_TOKEN/
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 200
```
Please provide the top 10 hits and remediation timestamp.
tom: Will attach sample hits with a signed HMAC and include the query used to pull them. Chain-of-custody notes to be in the bundle manifest.
maria: Scheduling retest: assessor available Tue 2026-03-30 afternoon. Can we target that? We need internal dry-run by Mon 2026-03-29 09:30 to validate everything.
aj: RBAC change needs a dry-run and small acceptance window. Can we push final apply to Mon AM and dry-run automated tests at 08:30? Requesting Mon AM for last checks.
infra-platform: KMS policy diff will be ready by Fri EOD for review. We will not apply until security sign-off and a documented rollback.
katie: I’ll coordinate QA to run verification tests Fri and Mon AM; will post results in this thread.
maria: Action items recap: 
- lina: produce redacted log snapshots + query samples + sample hits (due Fri EOD)
- aj: RBAC change plan + canary config + dry-run automation (due Mon 2026-03-29 08:30)
- infra-platform/tom: KMS policy diff, CloudTrail key events, and uploaded evidence bundle (policy diff due Fri EOD)
- katie: remediation runbook + verification template + QA scheduling (template due Thu COB)
- tom: upload HMAC-signed evidence bundle (done) and share presigned URL with assessor (done)
pen-test-bot: retest-slot reserved: session-9021 start 2026-03-30T14:00Z end 2026-03-30T17:00Z.
maria: If any of the owners foresee blockers meeting the deadlines, flag now. We9ll run a short dry-run sync Mon 09:30. Escalate with :rotating_light: and @oncall.
aj: I'll flag if RBAC tests show auth spikes. Will post metrics after dry-run.
lina: Starting log export now, will tag uploads to the evidence bundle as they finish.
katie: DMing QA to confirm Fri run.
maria: Thanks all. Keep updates here so we have an audit trail. Closing checklist will be updated after dry-run.
